WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Marksmanship build has been tested. Blizzard's own caveat applies to everything on this page: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

What Marksmanship is for

Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstant at exactly 20: +20% damage with all attacks, and only with no pet out. Eleven points reach it, and it is the one talent in the Hunter trees that pays you for fighting without a pet at all. The tree around it is pure shot damage: Lethal AttacksLethal AttacksTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%., widened in Forever from ranged-weapon crit to critical strike chance with all attacks; Careful AimCareful AimTalentCastInstantIncreases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect., which adds up to 100% of your Intellect to both melee and ranged Attack Power; and BarrageBarrageTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%., which now boosts Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 20. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot. on top of Multi-ShotMulti-ShotLevel 18 · Spell · PhysicalCast0.5 sec castRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldown and VolleyVolleyLevel 40 · Spell · ArcaneCastInstantCost350 ManaRange35 yd rangeDuration6 sec.

Where the sources point that capability is dungeons. "If you want to go deep into Marksmanship, the best use-case for it is for Dungeons, specifically to maximize your AoE damage." An extra 20% damage on Multi-ShotMulti-ShotLevel 18 · Spell · PhysicalCast0.5 sec castRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldown is a lot in a pull.

Two published verdicts say the same thing about soloing it, and they are kept here as attributed. Going 11 points deep to reach Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstant is described as "not a good general play build", with the recommendation to "use the Beast Mastery build at this level instead." Wowhead agrees from the other direction: "a pet will currently do more damage than the bonus you would get from Lone Wolf, so taking a couple of points in the BM tree is strongly advised."

Read that in proportion. At level 20 you have eleven points, the Hunter rotation is identical across all three specs, and most of the difference is four flexible talent points. Nobody is stuck.

So: Beast Mastery if you mostly quest alone, Marksmanship if you mostly run dungeons — that is the split the two quotes above draw. Our own reading, which no source states: neither choice is a mistake.

Your talent points

Level 20: 0/11/0, to reach Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstant.

The sequence is eleven points into Marksmanship. What you are buying is the tier-3 talent at the end of it, so the intermediate points follow the tree rather than a preference.

The warning that comes with it is explicit: "At low level, you should never take Lone Wolf unless your goal is to maximize your cleave and AoE damage in dungeons."

If you are questing, spec Beast Mastery instead: Deadly AspectsDeadly AspectsTalentCastInstant 5 and PathfindingPathfindingTalentCastInstantIncreases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%. 2, which the Beast Mastery page covers.

Below level 10, walk backwards between shots to stay out of the dead zone.

Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Agility, then the highest item level you can wear. As with every Hunter spec, the slower weapon is better — Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 20. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot. scales off damage per hit, not DPS. Hit is valuable but rarely appears on low-level gear.

What Forever changed for Hunters

  • Pets lost their per-family damage/armour modifiers. Icy Veins is explicit: "Pets no longer have an inherent damage buff or reduction based on type." What each family carries instead is one unique ability on top of a wider shared kit. But see Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstant above: the eleven-deep build and a live pet are alternatives, not partners. Blizzard confirms the mechanism: pets now scale their stats off your gear directly, and can no longer receive player buffs that increase their stats — one more reason a live pet and Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstant are a straight trade, not a stack.
  • Improved Serpent StingImproved Serpent StingTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%. became Improved StingsImproved StingsTalentCastInstant (moved from row 4 up to row 2), a larger Serpent Sting damage increase that now also shortens the Viper StingViper StingLevel 36 · Spell · NatureCast-1000 sec castCost135 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration8 sec cooldown and extends Scorpid StingScorpid StingLevel 22 · Spell · NatureCast-1000 sec castRange35 yd rangeDuration20 secStings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.'s duration. Build lists naming the old talent are stale.
  • Sniper ShotSniper ShotLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCast4 sec castCost365 ManaRange45 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration10 sec is Marksmanship's new capstone, the 31-point gold medal talent, which seems to require Trueshot AuraTrueshot AuraTalentCastInstantCost325 ManaDuration1800 sec first — Blizzard states the relation and not its direction, calling it only "pre-requisite of Trueshot Aura," and the October 1 notes don't settle it either, so the ordering here is read off tree position rather than stated. Confirmed by the October 1 build: a 4-second cast, 15-second cooldown shot that deals more damage than Aimed ShotAimed ShotLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCast2 sec castCost75 ManaRange35 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownAn aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 20. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot., with a 45-yard range, and it increases the range of your next 3 shots made within 10 seconds by 10 yards. Icy Veins calls out the obvious risk, that long a cast may turn out to be a damage loss in practice once real fights are played, though it will hit hard whenever you get the window.
  • The utility kit is unchanged and still the class's real advantage: Feign DeathFeign DeathLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost80 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration360 secFeign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 360 sec. At level 60

Unknown, and the open question for this spec is specific: whether Lone WolfLone WolfTalentCastInstant remains a dungeon-only talent or becomes the single-target choice once deeper Marksmanship talents exist to support it, and whether Sniper ShotSniper ShotLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCast4 sec castCost365 ManaRange45 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownDuration10 sec's four-second cast pays for itself.
